title: Forecast skill of WBGT and TWL at lead days 1–3, Abu Dhabi, Jun–Sep 2024–2025

attribution.weather: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), https://open-meteo.com/
attribution.era5: ERA5: contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
attribution.metar: METAR: Iowa Environmental Mesonet (IEM), Iowa State University — ASOS/METAR archive

config.leadDefinition: dN = value for the same valid time from runs issued ~24·N h earlier (Open-Meteo Previous Runs; 6-hourly models: d1 = leads 24–29 h). d0 = most recent run (leads 0–5 h), a short-range proxy for the analysis.
config.reference: Same-model: the model's own d0. Persistence: d0 at t − 24·N h. Airports: METAR (obs-met WBGT/TWL with model radiation).

events.label: ADOSH High zone (TWL ≤ 115 W/m², sun)
events.basis: ADOSH-SF TG v4.0 Table 1 via regulation.ts twlZone

bootstrap.block: site-day (resample whole local days of one site, with replacement)

config.engine: indices.ts computeSiteHeat per hour (Liljegren WBGT in sun; TWL in sun), no site radiant allowance
notes: Same-model scores measure how fast forecast error grows with lead time; they exclude the model's own bias and are therefore optimistic. The airport section shows the bias against observations.
ecmwf_ifs025 is the same IFS model as the live forecast but on a 0.25° grid, 3-hourly and interpolated to hourly; the production 9 km model (ecmwf_ifs) has Previous Runs only from 2025-10-01.
Airport verification covers three airports and one summer (2025); the airports stand in for the sites only approximately (station notes: OMAA ↔ musaffah/kezad, OMAD ↔ saadiyat, OMAL ↔ alain).
METAR temperatures are integers (±0.5 °C quantisation, about 0.29 °C RMS) and METAR carries no radiation, so the WBGT/TWL reference uses model radiation.

airports.method: Routine METAR at HH:00 UTC matched to the model value at the same instant (n ≈ 2,927 h per airport). Error = model − observation. WBGT/TWL reference = engine heat indices from METAR T, Td and 10 m wind with model radiation and surface pressure: the same model's fields for the analyses (§6.3), the IFS 9 km archive for the forecasts (§6.4). "T/Td only" keeps the model T/Td and uses the METAR wind.

airports.source: docs/research/data_and_validation.md §6.1, §6.3 and §6.4 (thermofeel 2.3.0, config A; n = 2,927 h)
